charset.description: The character set this engine uses for queries

classification.description: The classification of search engine according to the main search types.

identifier.description: The identifier of the search engine. This is also used to form the base telemetry id. TBD: This may be linked to the settings file and/or telemetry.
identifier.title: Identifier

name.description: The user visible name for the search engine.

environment.description: Specifies details of possible user environments that the engine or variant applies to

applicationId.description: The application(s) this applies to (default/not specified is everywhere)
applicationId.title: Application Identifiers

channel.description: An array of release channels that this applies to (not set = everywhere).
channel.title: Release Channel

distributions.description: An array of distribution identifiers that this applies to.

excludedDistributions.description: An array of distribution identifiers that this does not apply to.
excludedDistributions.title: Distributions

experiment.description: The experiment that this applies to, if blank it is associated with any configuration.
experiment.title: Experiment

locales.description: An array of locales that this applies to. 'default' will apply to situations where we have not been able to detect the user's locale. 'all' applies to all locales and should be specified as a single entry.
locales.title: Locales

maxVersion.description: The maximum version this applies to (less-than comparison)
maxVersion.title: Maxium Version

minVersion.description: The minimum version this applies to
minVersion.title: Minimum Version

regions.description: An array of regions that this applies to. 'default' will apply to situations where we have not been able to detect the user's region. 'all' applies to all regions and should be specified as a single entry.
regions.title: Regions

environment.title: Environment

base.description: The PrePath and FilePath of the URL. May include variables for engines which have a variable FilePath.
base.title: Base

method.description: The HTTP method to use to send the request. If not specified, defaults to GET.
method.title: Method

experimentConfig.description: The value for the parameter will be derived from the experiment configuration value.
experimentConfig.title: Experiment Configuration

fixedValue.description: The parameter value when it does not change.
fixedValue.title: Fixed Value

partnerCodeParamName.description: The name of the query parameter for the partner code.
partnerCodeParamName.title: Partner Code Parameter Name

searchTermParamName.description: The name of the query parameter for the search term. Automatically appended to the end of the query. This may be skipped if `{searchTerm}` is included in the base.
searchTermParamName.title: Search Term Parameter Name

urls.description: The URLs associated with the search engine.

search.title: Search URL

suggestions.description: The URL to use for suggestions
suggestions.title: Suggestions URL

trending.description: The URL to use for tending suggestions
trending.title: Trending Suggestions URL

urls.title: URLs

referenceName.description: A human readable name to help identify the record.
referenceName.title: Reference Name

variants.description: Variants of this search engine from the base.
